question: In a group of 40 boys, the average height was initially determined to be 160 cm. However, it was later discovered that the height of one boy was incorrectly recorded as 165 cm when it should have been 156 cm. Calculate the accurate average height.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net change in total sum = Correct value − Incorrect value = 156 − 165 = −9 cm.

Change in average = Net change ÷ Total boys = −9 ÷ 40 = −0.225 cm.

Correct average = Initial average + Change in average = 160 − 0.225 = 159.775 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 159.775 cm.**
